description: Fetch the current state of a blueprint run: status (pending/processing/awaiting_review/completed/failed), current step, and outputs when completed. Multi-output blueprints (listing-kit, hook-variants) return an `outputs` array of {label, url}; single-output blueprints return `output_url`. Download URLs are signed with a 10-minute TTL — re-fetch this run for fresh links. A caption-video run in status awaiting_review includes `srt_text`; review/edit it and resume with continue_blueprint_run.
name: get_blueprint_run
title: Get Blueprint Run
